headline: Farah Dahlgren and Harrow Point
body: Harrow Point issued new shares to Farah Dahlgren, which takes a 35% stake. Founded in 2011, Harrow Point Investments Foundation works in fuel trading.

headline: Saltmarsh and Velden Shoal
body: Saltmarsh now holds 51% of Velden Shoal after subscribing for new shares. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions. The price was not disclosed.

headline: Inés Orsini and Ashgrove Investments Holdings Ltd
body: Ashgrove Investments Holdings Ltd issued new shares to Inés Orsini, which takes a 60% stake. Ashgrove Investments Holdings Ltd works in insurance and is registered through Meridian Fiduciary.

headline: Noor Lombardi and Coral Gate
body: Noor Lombardi has agreed to buy 100% of Coral Gate from Zofia Kowalczyk. The deal still needs approval from the Quezal Financial Authority. Founded in 2007, Coral Gate Investments IBC works in fishing.

headline: Mei Thorne and Kestrel Isle Holdings
body: Kestrel Isle Holdings issued new shares to Mei Thorne, which takes a 60% stake. The price was not disclosed. Founded in 2017, Kestrel Isle Holdings Foundation works in commodities.

headline: Sable Strand Fishing Cooperative and Tamsin Bay Growers Cooperative Foundation
body: Sable Strand Fishing Cooperative now holds 10% of Tamsin Bay Growers Cooperative Foundation after subscribing for new shares. Founded in 2012, Tamsin Bay Growers Cooperative Foundation works in property.

headline: Brightwater Capital and Brightwater Assets
body: Brightwater Capital now holds 55% of Brightwater Assets after subscribing for new shares. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions.

headline: Zofia Kowalczyk and Amberley Sound
body: Zofia Kowalczyk now holds 60% of Amberley Sound after subscribing for new shares. Amberley Sound Holdings Holdings Ltd works in property and is registered through Quezal Incorporations.

headline: Jun Jaramillo and Velden Shoal Capital
body: Jun Jaramillo now holds 25% of Velden Shoal Capital after subscribing for new shares. Founded in 2014, Velden Shoal Capital IBC works in tourism.

headline: Sigrid Jaramillo and Larkspur Energy
body: Sigrid Jaramillo now holds 40% of Larkspur Energy after subscribing for new shares. Founded in 2012, Larkspur Energy Holdings Ltd works in fuel trading.

headline: Marrow Bay Holdings and Saltmarsh Trading IBC
body: Saltmarsh Trading IBC issued new shares to Marrow Bay Holdings, which takes a 60% stake. Saltmarsh Trading IBC works in fuel trading and is registered through Harbourline Corporate Services.

headline: Kestrel Isle and Low Cay
body: Kestrel Isle now holds 75% of Low Cay after subscribing for new shares. The price was not disclosed. Low Cay Trading Holdings Ltd works in commodities and is registered through Harbourline Corporate Services.

headline: New director at Ashgrove Logistics
body: Inés Orsini joins the board of Ashgrove Logistics Foundation. The price was not disclosed.

headline: Caio Beaulieu and Tamsin Bay Ventures Foundation
body: Caio Beaulieu has agreed to buy 49% of Tamsin Bay Ventures Foundation from Astrid Winterbourne. The deal still needs approval from the Quezal Financial Authority. The price was not disclosed.

headline: New director at Greywind
body: Viggo Iversen joins the board of Greywind Investments Partners Holdings Ltd. Founded in 2024, Greywind Investments Partners Holdings Ltd works in fishing. Greywind Investments Partners Holdings Ltd works in fishing and is registered through Cay & Partners Registered Agents.

headline: New director at Larkspur
body: Alba Jaramillo joins the board of Larkspur Resources IBC. Larkspur Resources IBC works in commodities and is registered through Harbourline Corporate Services. The price was not disclosed.

headline: Valentin Winterbourne and Harrow Point Investments Foundation
body: Harrow Point Investments Foundation issued new shares to Valentin Winterbourne, which takes a 40% stake. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions. Founded in 2011, Harrow Point Investments Foundation works in fuel trading.

headline: Orla Schofield and Tamsin Bay Growers Cooperative Foundation
body: Tamsin Bay Growers Cooperative Foundation issued new shares to Orla Schofield, which takes a 12% stake. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions.

headline: Larkspur and Amberley Sound Fuels LLC
body: Larkspur has bought a 16% stake in Amberley Sound Fuels LLC from Nico Holt, the companies said on Tuesday. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions.

headline: Quillon changes its name
body: Quillon Head Assets Holdings Ltd will trade as Greywind Fuels Holdings Ltd from next month, its board said. Founded in 2004, Quillon Head Assets Holdings Ltd works in insurance. The price was not disclosed.

headline: Mei Thorne and Greywind
body: Mei Thorne now holds 5% of Greywind after subscribing for new shares. Greywind Terminals Holdings Ltd works in telecoms and is registered through Harbourline Corporate Services. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions.

headline: Marrow changes its name
body: Marrow Bay Fuels LLC will trade as Velden Shoal Terminals LLC from next month, its board said. Marrow Bay Fuels LLC works in port services and is registered through Cay & Partners Registered Agents. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions.

headline: Omar Hollis and Amberley Sound
body: Court papers filed this week show that Omar Hollis has owned 16% of Amberley Sound since September 2023. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions. Founded in 2015, Amberley Sound Fuels LLC works in port services.

headline: Astrid Winterbourne and Velden Shoal Partners
body: Court papers filed this week show that Astrid Winterbourne has owned 100% of Velden Shoal Partners since January 2017. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions.

headline: Nico Holt and Greywind Investments Holdings Ltd
body: Court papers filed this week show that Nico Holt has owned 100% of Greywind Investments Holdings Ltd since September 1998. Greywind Investments Holdings Ltd works in shipping and is registered through Meridian Fiduciary. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions.

headline: Saltmarsh changes its name
body: Saltmarsh Partners IBC will trade as Wexmoor Partners IBC from next month, its board said. Saltmarsh Partners IBC works in shipping and is registered through Harbourline Corporate Services. The price was not disclosed.

headline: Calder Reef Ventures IBC and Low Cay Fuels LLC
body: Calder Reef Ventures IBC has bought a 15.33% stake in Low Cay Fuels LLC from Anders Holt, the companies said on Tuesday. The price was not disclosed. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions.

headline: Valentin Winterbourne and Larkspur Shipping
body: Valentin Winterbourne now holds 7.5% of Larkspur Shipping after subscribing for new shares. Founded in 2021, Larkspur Shipping Foundation works in fishing.

headline: Nico Velasco and Larkspur
body: Larkspur issued new shares to Nico Velasco, which takes a 12% stake. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions.

headline: New director at Sable Strand Investments
body: Gideon Yoshida joins the board of Sable Strand Investments LLC. Founded in 2006, Sable Strand Investments LLC works in shipping.

headline: Anders Holt and Pellow Rock
body: Pellow Rock issued new shares to Anders Holt, which takes a 5% stake. The price was not disclosed. Founded in 2018, Pellow Rock Holdings Foundation works in fishing.

headline: Saltmarsh Trading and Marrow Bay Fuels
body: Valentin Winterbourne sold 15.67% of Marrow Bay Fuels to Saltmarsh Trading, according to a filing seen by the Gazette. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions.
